title: Duplicate Charge Refund Policy
policy_text: If a customer is billed more than once for the same subscription period or add-on purchase, support may approve a refund for the extra charge after verifying the duplicate transaction. Refunds should be issued to the original payment method and communicated with an expected settlement window of three to five business days.

title: Post-Renewal Grace Period Refund Policy
policy_text: Customers who cancel shortly after an automatic renewal may receive a refund when the request falls within the defined grace period and usage remains limited. Agents should confirm the renewal timestamp, cancellation timing, and whether premium features were used after renewal before approving the request.

title: Subscription Cancellation and Access Policy
policy_text: Canceling a subscription stops future renewals but does not remove access immediately for prepaid time already covered. Agents should clearly explain the effective end date and confirm that no additional recurring billing will occur after cancellation is completed.

title: Account Security Recovery Policy
policy_text: Any report of unauthorized login changes, suspicious access, or ownership disputes requires immediate account protection steps. Support must lock sensitive account actions, initiate identity verification, and route the case to the security or trust review queue when unauthorized access is suspected.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Assistance Policy
policy_text: When a customer cannot receive or complete multi-factor verification, support may help with approved backup methods after confirming account ownership. Agents must not bypass ownership checks, and repeated delivery failures should be documented for product review.

title: Failed Payment Retry Policy
policy_text: When a renewal or manual payment fails, support should first confirm whether the issuer declined the payment, whether billing details are current, and whether retry timing limits apply. Agents may advise customers to update billing information and retry, but should not guarantee approval by the card issuer.

title: Tax Exemption Billing Policy
policy_text: Accounts marked as tax-exempt should not be charged sales tax after valid exemption records are approved. If tax is charged in error, support should update the billing profile and explain whether a corrected invoice or refund adjustment will follow according to billing operations review.

title: Technical Incident Communication Policy
policy_text: When a known product incident affects multiple customers, support should avoid speculative promises and instead provide the current verified status, known workaround if one exists, and the next update expectation. High-impact business scenarios may be escalated to incident communications or engineering operations.
